2: Authors cannot confidently determine which part; comment does not specify what needs to be addressed.
3: Authors cannot confidently determine which part; comment clearly specifies what needs to be addressed.

The comment explicitly mentions "Figure 4B" and specifies two concrete issues: (1) missing correlation coefficients in the figure, (2) missing PFC predicted vs ground truth size plot while text describes both HC and PFC. This clearly meets score 5 criteria: explicitly mentions the part, and specifies what needs to be addressed.

- Rubric correctness: whether the rationale correctly interprets and applies the task-specific scoring criteria.
